subject.title: Feature Request: Add MathJax/LaTeX Support to Control UI

question: Should OpenClaw accept LaTeX/math rendering in the core Control UI, and if so what default, config, dependency, and sanitizer/CSP policy should it use?
rationale: The request is useful and source-supported, but it adds browser-rendering dependency surface and possibly a new config/default surface, which repository policy reserves for maintainer product/security judgment.

options.title: Sponsor a bounded core implementation
options.body: Choose one existing PR or replacement branch and require bundled no-CDN rendering, sanitizer/CSP review, tests, docs/config alignment, and real Control UI proof before merge.

options.title: Require an extension/API path first
options.body: Keep this issue open as a plugin/API design item if maintainers want math rendering outside the core renderer but current plugin seams cannot safely inject it yet.

options.title: Decline core math rendering
options.body: Close the cluster as not planned if maintainers decide formula rendering is outside the Control UI product boundary for now.

recommendation.title: Sponsor a bounded core implementation
recommendation.body: Choose one existing PR or replacement branch and require bundled no-CDN rendering, sanitizer/CSP review, tests, docs/config alignment, and real Control UI proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc merged the current renderer-layout PR and has recent adjacent Control UI history, making them the best available routing owner from the inspected evidence.
